network_status.network: Evento del pomeriggio di giovedi 16 maggio 2024: la sintesi
network_status.summary_it: La sintesi ufficiale ARPAV documenta la fase temporalesca intensa nel Vicentino, ma non pubblica un livello o una portata evento-specifici sul torrente Orolo a Malo. La pioggia osservata non viene convertita in idrometria.
network_status.summary_en: The official ARPAV review documents the intense thunderstorm phase in the Vicenza area but publishes no event-specific stage or discharge for the Orolo at Malo. Observed rainfall is not converted into hydrometry.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
